Land small commits early so they rebase onto you. RELEASE: one cut carries ISSUE:0007, ST0002 and ST0003 (hv, 2026-11-13: "one cut, everything in"). ISSUE:0003: your hold 6 stands as it is. ST0003's rollout may replace its steps 3 and 4; that waits on hv's trial (ST0003/WP01), and I will tell you. HAND OVER with the commit range, your one measured run and what you want read.
